title: Pretty Dinner Plate, But With Flaws on Back
text:
Pretty Dinner Plate, But With Flaws on Back. In my home, this pretty MARCHESA SHADES OF BLUE DINNER PLATE (by Lenox) will see duty as a cookie/cake plate. The scalloped edges, accented with gold, make it perfect for presenting desserts and treats. The product page photo is very accurate as to the color, which is baby blue with a hint of teal. The plate is ironstone, so it weighs more than porcelain, but it's thin, and not particularly heavy (unlike some stoneware).

However, I was surprised to find three very conspicuous flaws in the glaze on the back of the dinner plate (left side, right side, bottom center), because this plate is not cheap (about $26 on Amazon). These surely are caused by contact with a rack during the firing of the glaze. I don't know whether it's normal to find such flaws in dinnerware in this price range, but I was disappointed.
